name: presentation-agent-collection-policy
purpose: Define source collection, license gating, raw asset storage, and PPTX-to-HTML conversion rules for the presentation-agent project.

reader_guide.summary: This file tells agents how to collect presentation design references and assets without copying copyrighted decks or templates by default.
how_to_read: Read structure_rules first to understand where references, raw assets, and conversions belong.
Use license_gate before downloading or converting any raw PPT/PPTX/image/icon/font file.
Use collection_lanes to split future source gathering into safe parallel research lanes.
Use pptx_to_html_policy before deciding whether a PPTX should be extracted, rebuilt, or routed to a high-fidelity converter study.
update_triggers: A new presentation source type or asset class is added.
A raw asset storage rule changes.
A PPTX-to-HTML conversion strategy is adopted or retired.
A license or attribution policy changes.
reader_guide.default_language: Korean documentation, English executable prompt bodies
reader_guide.copyright_position: Store source metadata by default. Store raw PPT/PPTX/assets only when the source license or explicit permission allows local reuse.

structure_rules.rule: Keep project-specific presentation agent code, configs, docs, tests, data, and generated artifacts under presentation-agent/.
structure_rules.reason: The workspace treats each root project as its own ownership boundary.

structure_rules.rule: Keep raw assets under data/assets/raw/ only after license and terms review.
structure_rules.reason: Visible online content is not automatically reusable or locally storable.

structure_rules.rule: Keep converted HTML under data/conversions/html/ or artifacts/html/ with a provenance note linking the source catalog record.
structure_rules.reason: Every conversion must remain traceable to its source and license decision.

structure_rules.rule: Use data/reference-index/ for source metadata and source-quality scoring, not for copied copyrighted slide files.
structure_rules.reason: The catalog is a provenance and planning layer, not a bulk template mirror.

structure_rules.rule: Use docs/research/ for reusable research notes and source synthesis.
structure_rules.reason: Future presentation agents need compact, reviewed knowledge instead of raw search traces.

field_guide.meaning: Parallel-safe research lanes for finding frameworks, templates, galleries, assets, theory, and research.
Rules that decide whether raw files can be stored or whether a source must remain metadata-only.
Rules for extracting, rebuilding, or researching conversion of PPTX decks into HTML.
True only when local raw storage is compatible with the current license status and still requires item-level review for real assets.
The intended route for turning a source into HTML or using it as an HTML deck reference.

collection_lanes.goal: Collect web-native slide systems that can directly produce HTML decks.
Collect high-volume PPT/Google Slides/Figma template sources with visible design variety.
Collect inspiration sources where popularity and designer response can indicate visual quality.
collection_lanes.output: records with download_allowed=false unless individual asset license is checked

collection_lanes.goal: Collect reusable images, icons, fonts, illustrations, and motion assets for deck production.
Collect evidence about storytelling, slide structure, cognitive load, and AI slide evaluation.
collection_lanes.output: records used for script-flow and evaluation agents

pptx_to_html_policy.default_strategy: Convert only permitted local PPTX files. Use the built-in converter for text structure and evidence extraction, not as a high-fidelity visual renderer.
high_fidelity_options_to_research_later: dedicated PPTX to HTML open-source converter after license/security review
prohibited_actions: Do not download paid or account-gated templates through third-party sharing requests.
Do not store copyrighted template files only because they are viewable online.
Do not present a visual conversion as faithful unless layout was rendered and checked.
